request.style: English, blues, solo male voice, raw and weary, acoustic guitar, upright bass, harmonica, slow groove, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mikloth fathered Shimeah in the land
These also lived opposite their kinsmen in Jerusalem
Along with their kinsmen they stayed there
The register names them in the tribal hall

[Chorus]
Lived in Jerusalem with their relatives
Opposite their kinsmen in the city
Mikloth was the father of Shimeam
Near their kinsmen in the holy land

[Verse]
Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived there
His wife was named Maacah in the place
Abdon was firstborn then Zur and Kish
Ner fathered Kish and Kish fathered Saul

[Chorus]
Lived in Jerusalem with their relatives
Opposite their kinsmen in the city
Mikloth was the father of Shimeam
Near their kinsmen in the holy land

[Bridge]
Jonathan son of Shimeah struck him down
When he taunted Israel in the fight
Shimeah was the brother of David
And his son was shrewd in the king's court

[Outro]
Mikloth fathered Shimeah
Lived opposite their kinsmen
